# uptimeify_im_service (Resource)

A service of the Incident Management service catalog ("Webshop", "Customer portal") with its criticality, the responsible team and its monitors. An incident of a monitor that belongs to exactly one service is linked to that service. Needs an organization token of an organization admin. Import with the numeric id or the public id.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "uptimeify_im_service" "webshop" {
  name          = "Webshop"
  description   = "Checkout and product pages."
  criticality   = "critical"
  owner_team_id = tonumber(uptimeify_im_team.platform.id)

  monitors = [
    { monitor_type = "website", monitor_id = tonumber(uptimeify_website.shop.id) },
    { monitor_type = "tcp", monitor_id = tonumber(uptimeify_tcp_monitor.db.id) },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) 1 to 200 characters, unique per organization regardless of case (409 `imServiceNameTaken`).

### Optional

- `criticality` (String) `critical`, `high`, `medium` (default) or `low`.
- `description` (String) Up to 2000 characters.
- `monitors` (Attributes Set) The monitors of this service, at most 500. Terraform owns the whole set; unset = none. Each must belong to the organization (404 `imServiceMonitorNotFound`). A monitor deleted later drops out of the service and shows up as a diff. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--monitors))
- `owner_team_id` (Number) Responsible team of the organization (404 `imTeamNotFound`). Deleting the team clears it.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `id` (String) Numeric service id.
- `organization_id` (Number)
- `public_id` (String)
- `updated_at` (String)

<a id="nestedatt--monitors"></a>
### Nested Schema for `monitors`

Required:

- `monitor_id` (Number) Numeric id of the monitor within its type, e.g. `tonumber(uptimeify_website.shop.id)`.
- `monitor_type` (String) `website` (also heartbeat and browser monitors), `dns`, `icmp`, `smtp`, `ssh`, `tcp`, `ftp` or `imap_pop`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Numeric service id or public id
terraform import uptimeify_im_service.webshop 12
```
